cases.sentence: К колодцу пришла за водой одна самарийская ___.
cases.translation: A Samaritan woman came to the well to draw water.
cases.explain: Женщина is the subject of пришла (came), so it is in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус, уставший после дороги, сел у ___ отдохнуть.
cases.translation: Jesus, tired from the journey, sat down by the well to rest.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by, at) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Настанет время, когда вы будете поклоняться ___ не на этой горе и не в Иерусалиме.
cases.translation: A time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The verb поклоняться (to worship) takes its object in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Пойди, позови своего ___ и возвращайся сюда.
cases.translation: Go, call your husband and come back here.
cases.explain: Мужа is the direct object of позови (call); for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Вода, которую я ему дам, станет в нем ___, текущим вечную жизнь.
cases.translation: The water that I give him will become in him a spring welling up to eternal life.
cases.explain: Источником is the predicate complement of станет (to become), which governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Бог есть Дух, и поклоняющиеся Ему должны поклоняться в ___ и истине.
cases.translation: God is Spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: К колодцу пришла за водой одна самарийская женщина.
reading.question: Who came to Jacob's well while Jesus rested there?
reading.explain: A Samaritan woman came to the well to draw water.

reading.ru: «Дай мне, пожалуйста, напиться воды», — попросил ее Иисус.
reading.question: What did Jesus ask the Samaritan woman for?
reading.explain: Jesus asked her for a drink of water.

reading.ru: Ты иудея, а я самарянка, как это ты можешь просить у меня напиться?
reading.question: Why was the Samaritan woman surprised Jesus spoke to her?
options: Because Jews did not associate with Samaritans
Because women could not speak to men
Because she was a foreigner from Rome
Because Jesus was a stranger to the region
reading.correct: Because Jews did not associate with Samaritans
reading.explain: She was surprised because Jews did not use vessels with Samaritans.

reading.ru: Тот же, кто пьет воду, которую я дам ему, никогда больше не будет мучим жаждой.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about the water he offers?
options: Whoever drinks it will never thirst again
It must be drawn fresh every day
It can only be given to Jews
reading.correct: Whoever drinks it will never thirst again
reading.explain: Jesus said whoever drinks the water he gives will never thirst again.

reading.question: What did the woman say about her husband?
reading.explain: The woman answered that she had no husband.

reading.ru: Ведь у тебя было пять мужей, и тот, с кем ты сейчас живешь, не муж тебе.
reading.question: What did Jesus reveal he knew about the woman's past?
options: That she had had five husbands and was not married to the man she now lived with
That she had never been married
That her husband had died recently
reading.correct: That she had had five husbands and was not married to the man she now lived with
reading.explain: Jesus revealed she had had five husbands and was not married to her current partner.

reading.ru: Бог есть Дух, и поклоняющиеся Ему должны поклоняться в Духе и истине.
reading.question: How does Jesus say people must worship God?
reading.explain: Jesus said God is Spirit and must be worshiped in spirit and truth.

reading.ru: Женщина оставила свой кувшин для воды, вернулась в город и сказала людям, «Идите и посмотрите на человека, который рассказал мне все, что я сделала. Не Христос ли он?»
reading.question: What did the woman do after speaking with Jesus?
options: She left her water jar, went to the city, and told people about the man
She stayed at the well all day
She refused to tell anyone what happened
She argued with Jesus and left angry
reading.correct: She left her water jar, went to the city, and told people about the man
reading.explain: She left her jar, went into the city, and told the people about Jesus.

reading.ru: поднимите глаза и посмотрите на поля, как они уже созрели для жатвы.
reading.question: What did Jesus tell his disciples to look at?
options: The fields, already ripe for harvest
reading.correct: The fields, already ripe for harvest
reading.explain: Jesus told them to look at the fields, already white for harvest.

reading.ru: Многие самаряне, жители этого города, уверовали в Иисуса, потому что женщина сказала, «Он рассказал мне все, что я сделала».
reading.question: Why did many Samaritans from the town believe in Jesus?
options: Because of the woman's testimony about Jesus
Because Jesus performed a miracle in the town square
Because a Pharisee vouched for him
Because he healed a blind man there
reading.correct: Because of the woman's testimony about Jesus
reading.explain: Many Samaritans believed because of the woman's testimony about Jesus.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, «Иди, твой сын будет жить».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the royal official whose son was dying?
reading.explain: Jesus told the official to go, for his son would live.

reading.ru: Отец понял, что это произошло именно тогда, когда Иисус сказал ему, «Твой сын будет жить».
reading.question: How did the official learn that Jesus's word had healed his son?
options: He realized the fever left at the exact hour Jesus spoke
He saw Jesus perform the healing in person
A neighbor confirmed it by letter
The boy told him personally a week later
reading.correct: He realized the fever left at the exact hour Jesus spoke
reading.explain: The father realized it happened at the very hour Jesus said his son would live.
